_doc: Stochastic drivers drawn in code for every run. Weights are relative. 'parent_modifiers' are simple reweightings keyed on the parent world state; keep them few and legible. The generator must treat the drawn values as facts true by the end of the two-year step.

adoption_delta_pp._note: Percentage-point change in share of US adults currently on an incretin drug over two years. Baseline trend 2024→2026 was +8 pp (3%→11%, Gallup). Negative values model a retreat (coverage loss, safety scare, price shock).

generic_collapse.desc: US cash price falls below ~$75/month as generics or near-generics arrive; access becomes an income floor question rather than a price question

managed_decline.desc: Prices step down through negotiated channels (TrumpRx-style, Medicare, PBM deals) but brands hold ~$150–300/month; access is still rationed by coverage

stalled.desc: Prices stop falling; litigation, patent extension or demand outpaces supply

shock_up.desc: Price or availability shock: tariff, manufacturing failure, recall, or withdrawal of a public program

public_expansion.desc: Medicare/Medicaid coverage widens; a public program becomes the default payer

employer_retreat.desc: Employers keep dropping weight-loss coverage; coverage concentrates on diabetes/cardiac codes; a two-tier access system hardens

status_quo.desc: No structural change in who pays

mandate_or_conditioning.desc: Coverage becomes conditional (BMI targets, adherence tracking) or is tied to employment, benefits or insurance premiums

new_indications._note: Number of new on-label or quasi-official indications arriving this step, then which.

alcohol_use_disorder.desc: Approved or guideline-endorsed for alcohol use disorder

compulsive_behaviour.desc: Gambling, shopping, screen or sexual compulsion — a 'compulsion' indication

longevity_wellness.desc: Off-label use for 'metabolic health' or longevity becomes mainstream among people without obesity

mood_and_motivation.desc: Reward-modulation marketed as a mood, focus or 'quiet mind' indication

none.desc: No new signal; existing ledger holds

muscle_bone_wave.desc: Lean-mass and bone-density losses become a recognised population problem, especially in older users and long-term users

vision_class_label.desc: Optic-nerve (NAION-type) risk moves from 'very rare' to a class warning

gi_pancreatic_litigation.desc: Gastroparesis / pancreatic litigation reaches mass-tort scale

anhedonia_labelled.desc: Reward-blunting / emotional flattening becomes a labelled adverse effect with a prevalence estimate

pediatric_developmental.desc: A developmental, growth or psychiatric signal in children who started young

novel_long_horizon.desc: An unforeseen effect appears only after 5+ years of continuous use

none.desc: No new class reaches market this step

triple_agonist_30pct.desc: A ~30%-weight-loss triple agonist launches; surgical-grade loss from a pen

oral_parity.desc: A pill matches injectables on efficacy; the needle barrier disappears

monthly_or_implant.desc: Monthly injection or implant; adherence stops being a choice you make weekly

muscle_preserving_combo.desc: Combination with a muscle-preserving agent; the 'skinny-frail' problem is sold as solved

generic_flood_counterfeits.desc: Cheap imports and counterfeits flood in; dosing errors and contaminated product become a public-health story

tariff_geopolitics.desc: Supply politicised: tariffs, export controls, a national-champion manufacturer

manufacturer_scandal.desc: Suppressed data, marketing misconduct or a trial scandal at a major manufacturer

gray_market_resurgence.desc: Compounding / telehealth gray market regrows outside regulation, including for next-gen molecules

normalisation.desc: Being on it is unremarkable; being off it is what needs explaining

backlash_body_politics.desc: A visible counter-movement: fat-acceptance revival, anti-pharma, religious or 'natural' framings

class_stratification.desc: Body shape reads as income; thinness and muscle become class uniforms

natural_movement.desc: An 'unmedicated' identity movement, with its own aesthetics and politics

aesthetic_inversion.desc: Thinness devalues as it becomes cheap; a new scarce body ideal emerges (muscle, appetite, 'unmedicated vitality')

subsidy.desc: Direct subsidy or free provision as public-health policy

restriction.desc: Age limits, prescribing caps, advertising bans

benefits_conditioning.desc: Benefits, premiums or employment conditioned on adherence or BMI; adherence monitored

workforce_military.desc: Programmes for soldiers, pilots, police, shift workers; the drug as readiness infrastructure

niche_side_effect.desc: Acknowledged in labels and clinics as an uncommon side effect

mainstream_complaint.desc: Widely discussed; dose adjustment and 'drug holidays' are common practice

marketed_feature.desc: Blunting is sold: calm, focus, freedom from craving — a wellness or productivity product

employer_encouraged.desc: Institutions prefer or reward the blunted; adherence correlates with employment
